articles.title: One Neighbor's Petition Helped Stop a $5 Billion Data Center
articles.summary: Taylor Frazier McCollum, who lives near the old Landover Mall site, gathered more than 25,000 signatures and helped block a $5 billion data center in her Maryland county.

articles.title: Paraguay's President Removed From Office After Bank Collapse
articles.summary: Paraguay's president was impeached and placed under house arrest after a bank collapse left millions unable to reach their savings.

articles.title: Georgia Elects Keisha Lance Bottoms as First Black Woman Governor in U.S. History
articles.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms will be Georgia's first Democratic governor in over two decades — and the first Black woman ever elected governor in the United States.
